adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return `nil`, but the code immediately calls `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without a nil guard, which will raise `NoMethodError` (500) rather than returning a 404. Separately, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]` exist; if `params[:embeddable_host]` is missing, it will raise (500). Even if the param exists but `host` is nil, the model `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` and would also crash when `host` is nil. These are verifiable from the diff.
